static_traits.name: Zhang Ruolan
static_traits.social_status: Difficulty connecting with new friends; Self-doubt affecting interactions with colleagues in social and Work settings; has one friend to confide in, but not yet shared current inadequacy and Self-doubt feelings
static_traits.medical_history: No similar problem history; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Tense but willing to seek help; clear expression, able to recall situations concretely; coherent logic, highly cooperative; marked Self-monitoring and Self-doubt on social topics, thinking often showing mind-reading and personalization tendencies

basic_info.main_problem: I feel that because of my Accountant work, people find me very boring, which makes me feel not good enough and Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: I hope to be more confident, care less about what others think of me, and be able to stop constantly fearing judgment in Social situations and enjoy them.
growth_experiences: Years ago, colleagues often joked that 'Accountants are boring'; this impression gradually solidified in Zhang Ruolan's mind, making her continuously worry about being labeled 'boring' in Social situations and at Work. Pressure was moderate at first, then intensified with ongoing worry; she tried cultivating different hobbies to prove she is not boring, but still feels misunderstood.

special_situations.event: Being asked about occupation at Social gatherings or when meeting new friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others know I am an Accountant, they will find me boring and will not want to talk deeply with me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing or overexerts when present, to prove oneself not boring
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They find me dull and will not want to talk with me

special_situations.event: At last week's industry social event, when asked about career
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others learn my occupation, subsequent interactions will surely turn bad
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces speaking, leaves occasions early to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Once they know I am an Accountant, they will distance themselves from me

special_situations.event: When receiving visitors or clients at the office
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: At Work occasions I struggle to show an interesting side; others will thus label me 'boring', and my value will be negated
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-monitoring words and actions, deliberately pandering or shortening exchanges
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone entering my office finds me very boring

special_situations.event: Hearing colleagues' jokes about 'Accountants being boring'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' jokes about the occupation are negating my personal value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proving oneself not boring by adding hobbies; more sensitive to socializing

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized, liked, and seen as one's true self
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being labeled 'boring' and being rejected or humiliated
defense_goal: Maintaining safety and avoiding negative evaluation through avoidance or Self-monitoring

object_relations.self_representation: A judged self prone to being misunderstood

manifestations: Feeling out of place and retreating at Social gatherings
Worries about being judged and avoids building connections with new friends
Not yet sharing inadequacy with friends, feeling hard to be understood
outcomes: Social Withdrawal and Increased sense of isolation

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Over-focusing on whether one is boring in social situations, too cautious to express naturally
Repressing real interests and views out of worry about others' opinions

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'
manifestations: Assuming others must find oneself boring
Extrapolating Self-doubt into others' negative evaluations

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Wanting to initiate conversation in Social situations but repressing the impulse, turning to self-Withdrawal
Relieving Anxiety through avoidance rather than direct interaction

positive_force: Willing to seek professional help and express problems clearly
Work performance not yet clearly affected, able to maintain occupational functioning
Proactively trying to improve self-image by cultivating different hobbies
Having a friend to confide in (though not yet sharing this specific distress)
negative_force: Tends toward mind reading and personalization, over-assuming others hold negative views of her
Self-labeling, believing occupation determines personal worth
Social avoidance and retreat, reducing reality-testing opportunities
Self-doubt and dependence on external validation, over-caring about others' views
Ongoing worry about being labeled 'boring' intensifying pressure

antecedent: At Social gatherings or when meeting new friends
When asked about one's job or talking about work
Hearing others' jokes about Accountants being 'boring'
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalizing colleagues' jokes as self-labels, and mind-reading plus catastrophizing others' evaluations, fearing negation
target_behavior.function: Escaping judgment and Anxiety, gaining short-term safety
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty connecting with new friends, Increased sense of isolation, Decreased self-confidence

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive Self-monitoring and worrying about others' views
antecedent: When receiving visitors or clients at work
Being asked to introduce oneself at social events
target_behavior.core_reason: Deep belief 'I am a boring person/I am not good enough', using external approval as the source of value
target_behavior.function: Tries to reduce negative evaluation by controlling words and actions
target_behavior.consequence: Stiff and exhausting communication, worsening Self-doubt, affecting interaction with colleagues and daily self-care and leisure
